family.description: This family (previously DUF4586) represents Cilia- and flagella-associated protein 96 (CFAP96, also known as C4orf47). CFAP96 is an axonemal microtubule-associated protein (MAP). The EM structure of sperm DMTs shows that CFAP96 binds to tubulin and, similarly to other axonemal wedge-MAPs, binds deeper into the inter-protofilament cleft making extensive contacts with flanking protofilaments [[cite:PUB00151496]].
family.name: Cilia-and flagella-associated protein 96
